capabilities: Create notes by running intents defined in a note's frontmatter
Prompt for typed variable values (text, number, natural date, note, folder)
Insert variable values into templates, output paths, and note names
Import and merge intents from other configuration notes
Prepopulate prompts from selected text and replace selection with a link
extras: Notes that the GIFs show outdated frontmatter configuration; full schema lives in a separate Intents Schema File, so troubleshooting points to the developer console and external docs.
problem: Obsidian's core Templates inserts static content and offers no way to capture values through prompts or configure note creation per note.

relations.evidence: Another plugin called "Filtered Opener" is required to select a note from your vault.
A natural date provided the natural language dates plugin.
it will run its templating after the variables of this plugin are replaced
Both plugins show prompts and use the selection to pre-populate fields

summary: Templating plugin that runs frontmatter-configured intents to create notes, prompting for typed variable values inserted into templates, paths, and names.
